description: This file defines traits and classes related to elements in a data flow graph within Spark SQL pipelines, including inputs, outputs, tables, views, and sinks, with implementations for various data source types and schema inference.

classes.name: GraphElement
classes.description: Trait representing an element in a data flow graph, with an origin, identifier, and display name.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Trait for elements that can load data as a DataFrame, referencing a data source.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Sealed trait representing an output node in the data flow graph.

classes.name: Dataset
classes.description: Trait for dataset outputs with normalized storage path and access to the data path.

classes.name: TableInput
classes.description: Trait for inputs that load data from a table, with optional user-specified schema.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Class representing a materialized dataset table with schema, partitioning, clustering, and path info.

classes.name: VirtualTableInput
classes.description: Class for virtual tables inferred from flows, with schema inference and support for streaming.

classes.name: View
classes.description: Trait for graph views, with identifier, properties, SQL text, and comments.

classes.name: TemporaryView
classes.description: Class representing a temporary view in the data flow graph.

classes.name: PersistedView
classes.description: Class representing a persisted view in the data flow graph.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Trait for sink elements with format and options.

classes.name: SinkImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a sink with identifier, format, options, and origin.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Method to load data from a table or source, returning a DataFrame.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns the normalized storage location path for a dataset or throws if unresolved.

methods.name: datasetType
methods.description: Returns the type of dataset, e.g., streaming table or materialized view.

methods.name: getFinalSchema
methods.description: Infers or returns the specified schema for a virtual table.

methods.name: createEmptyDF
methods.description: Creates an empty DataFrame based on a schema, supporting streaming and batch.
